claims.claim: On September 23, 2026, the company announced appointment of Taishin International Bank and Huanan Commercial Bank as handling banks for the third domestic unsecured convertible bond

ASML and TSMC announced cooperation to promote High NA EUV process transition to 12-inch masks, with target completion 2030-2033
TSMC and Samsung will adopt ASML's new EUV equipment
SEMI predicts that in 2027, 300mm wafer fab equipment spending will exceed $150 billion
Taiwan is constructing a high-tech industrial park in Kaohsiung where TSMC plans to establish a technology verification center and talent training base

Jiading (3680) reported H1 2026 EPS of 8.09 yuan

In Jiading's August investor conference, the company indicated optimistic H2 2026 shipment expectations, particularly for Taiwan advanced process wafer carrier demand, with EUV Pod and FOUP sales exceeding expectations
